question: Who was the first Portuguese governor in India, sent in 1505 to establish naval supremacy?
solution:
The correct answer is __**De Almeida**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Francisco de Almeida** was appointed as the **first Portuguese governor in India** in the year **1505**.
 
• He was given the title of **Viceroy** and was tasked with strengthening Portuguese naval supremacy in the Indian Ocean region.
 
• Francisco de Almeida implemented the policy of the **Blue Water Strategy** (Maritime Supremacy). This strategy emphasized controlling the seas rather than extensive territorial expansion. *Hence, this statement is correct.*
 
• The Portuguese established their first base in India at **Cochin** during Almeida's tenure. This marked the beginning of Portuguese colonial influence in India.
 
• Francisco de Almeida was known for his aggressive naval tactics. He defeated several Arab fleets and local rulers to establish Portuguese dominance along the western coast of India. *Hence, his actions were pivotal for Portuguese success.*
 
• His tenure as Viceroy ended in **1509**, and he was succeeded by **Afonso de Albuquerque**, who continued Portuguese expansion in India. *This fact is historically significant.*
 
• ***Hence, the correct answer is De Almeida.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Francisco de Almeida:**

 
 
• **Francisco de Almeida** served as the first Viceroy of Portuguese India from **1505 to 1509**.
 
• His **Blue Water Strategy** aimed at ensuring Portuguese naval supremacy in the Indian Ocean and controlling key trade routes.
 
• He established Portuguese control over key ports such as **Cochin**, **Canannore**, and other areas along the Malabar Coast.
 
 
 
• **Portuguese Expansion in India:**
 
 
• The Portuguese were the first Europeans to establish a lasting colonial presence in India, starting in the early 16th century.
 
• After Almeida, **Afonso de Albuquerque** expanded Portuguese territories further by capturing Goa in **1510**.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Portuguese Colonization:**
 
 
• The Portuguese introduced new trade goods, cultural influences, and religious conversions in India.
 
• They played a crucial role in establishing European dominance over Indian Ocean trade, which lasted for several centuries.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Other Portuguese Governors:**

 
 
• **Afonso de Albuquerque:** Known as the second Viceroy of Portuguese India, he captured **Goa** in **1510** and strengthened Portuguese power.
 
• **Nuno da Cunha:** Served as Governor of Portuguese India from **1529 to 1538** and played a crucial role in expanding Portuguese influence in the region.
 
• **Martim Afonso de Sousa:** Another notable Portuguese governor who served from **1542 to 1545** and focused on administrative and economic reforms.
 
 
 
• **Legacy of Portuguese Rule:**
 
 
• The Portuguese left a lasting cultural impact on India, especially in Goa, which is evident in architecture, cuisine, and religion.
 
• They were among the first to introduce European-style fortifications, firearms, and new navigational techniques in India.
